defaults-auto.title: Auto refill · new-bus defaults
defaults-auto.sub: Only used as seed values when creating a new bus. Changing these doesn't affect existing buses.

enabled.label: Enable auto refill on new buses
enabled.hint: New buses will start with this on. Existing buses aren't affected.

watermark.label: Default watermark
watermark.hint: New buses trigger auto refill when live keys drop below this. 0 = disabled by default.

min-count.label: Default minimum keys per refill
min-count.hint: New buses pull at least this many keys per auto refill
min-count.placeholder: blank = fill the gap each round

defaults-auto.alert: Each bus can freely override these. Changing global doesn't affect existing buses.

guardrails.title: Auto refill · cross-bus guardrails
guardrails.sub: Applied to all auto-refill buses combined. Manual pulls are never blocked.

daily-budget.label: Daily budget (credits)
daily-budget.hint: Max credits all auto buses can spend per day. Auto refill pauses when hit. Manual pulls unaffected.

min-reserve.label: Wallet reserve (credits)
min-reserve.hint: If wallet drops below this, all auto refills pause. You can still pull manually.

allowlist.label: Auto refill allowed upstreams
allowlist.hint: Only ticked upstreams may be used by auto refill. Empty = no restriction (all enabled upstreams). Manual pulls unaffected.
allowlist.empty: No restriction. Any enabled upstream may be used for auto refill.

guardrails.alert: These three only affect auto refill. Manual pulls (create bus, pull now, click pull) always work regardless.
